_readme: Settings for scripts/generate-voice.js. direction adds eleven_v3 audio tags in front of a line (keyed by the audio file name). Test lines have no tags: they are the reference the accent score compares against. characters.<id>.voiceId gives a character (e.g. a cast greeting) its own voice.
